message:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
I’d like to offer you a job because I need you to create a UGC video.

Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001]!
Of course, please send me the details!
The video needs to be in Arabic MSA.
You can find all the information here: [URL_001]
45$ for this video
Are you working with Bohdana? She contacted me about the same application.
However, she and I agreed on 50 since you don’t have an Arabic script, meaning I also need to translate it.
That’s fine; we can set it at 50$.
yeah :)
May I open a contract for you?
Yes, definitely! Please send the script as well so I can translate it, although that will take a bit.
script here
Please review the script, then let me know whether I can open a contract for you.

Oh yes, I already have it, and everything looks good!
You may go ahead with the contract.
I’ve accepted! Should I upload it to Google Drive once it’s finished?
yes please :)
Hello! This link doesn’t work :(
Please either send the video directly here or post its link here.
oh weird
one sec
Here’s the link: [URL_002]
The link works, and anyone who has it is able to view the file!
Confirm please
feedback soon, thanks

1\. Start by acting as though you’re reading the question from your phone
2\. Tap the screen with a bit more confidence and at the appropriate moments
3\. Follow the script somewhat more closely; it’s okay for the video to be slightly longer
4\. In general, I’d prefer it to be filmed in a cozy, home-like setting with a room interior behind you
but overall, I really like it) she’s charismatic
I’ll record it while sitting on the couch :) I’ll send it today or tomorrow.
thanks! waiting!
Also, the version I sent is 40 seconds long; exactly how long would you like it to be?
1 minute ?
below 1 minute
Hello! Please post it directly here in the chat.
Here is the link: [URL_003]
Hello! This time, you didn’t follow the script...
Please film the video again and say every phrase exactly as written.

Hi, first, I followed the phrases exactly in both this video and the previous one, not just this time. Both videos were precisely what you requested and were even better than the sample video you provided.

Second, how can you be so certain about the phrases when you didn’t have a translated script and asked me to translate it myself?

I won’t reshoot because both videos are great. If you don’t like them, tell me and pay at least half of the amount. I’m reporting this to Upwork.
